title: Xila developer manifest (experimental v1)
description: Editable developer configuration for xila-package bundle build. No files, sizes, hashes or signatures are written by developers; they are generated from the payload directory.

$schema.description: Optional editor-facing schema URL. This pointer is not a trust anchor and is never fetched by the Xila runtime.

format_version.description: Experimental v1 wire format. Breaking changes may occur before the format is frozen.

name.description: Stable reverse-DNS-style package identity; also the application ID when application is not null.

relativePath.description: Nonempty bundle-relative path. No . or .. components, symlinks or special entries; the runtime additionally enforces UTF-8 byte-size limits.

systemExecutable.description: Reference to an existing preinstalled executable. This does not imply permissions or package ownership.

entrypoint.description: Bundle-relative application executable. The build tool ensures it exists in the generated signed file inventory.

icon.description: Optional bundle-relative icon. The build tool ensures it exists in the generated signed file inventory.

show_in_launcher.description: Launcher discovery only; does not automatically pin to Dock.
